# Agent-X Documentation Index

**Documentation index for language models and other automated readers**

---

## Project Overview

**Project:** Agent-X
**Description:** Local-first AI document intelligence for Windows: import your documents,
search them by meaning, and ask questions answered from them with citations. The AI runs on
your computer by default; cloud providers and web search are opt-in.
**Version:** 2.2.0 ("Command Console")
**Repository:** https://github.com/Git-Rocky-Stack/Agent-X
**License:** MIT
**Main documentation:** docs/README.md

---

## Quick Links

- Quick Start: docs/user-guide/getting-started/quick-start.md
- Installation: SLIM installer (built-in model downloaded on first run) or OFFLINE installer
  (model bundled), from the GitHub Releases page
- First run: a five-step setup wizard (Ollama connection, model choice, built-in model
  download, optional OpenAI and Anthropic keys, summary). No passphrase.

---

## Key Concepts

**Agent-X:** Native Windows desktop app (.NET 8, WinUI 3) for working with your own documents
and an AI model.
**Built-in model:** Llama 3.2 3B Instruct (Q4_K_M GGUF, about 2 GB) run on your computer through
LLamaSharp. The default AI provider.
**Knowledge Vault:** The imported documents. Agent-X stores their extracted text and the path to
the original file; the file itself is not copied.
**Ask Your Files:** Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) page: answers from your indexed
documents with numbered citations.
**AI Chat:** General conversation with the active model. It does not search the Knowledge
Vault.
**Semantic Search:** Search by meaning (vector similarity), by keyword (SQLite FTS5), or both
(hybrid, merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, k=60).
**Collections:** Groups of documents; Ask Your Files and Semantic Search can be limited to one.
**Knowledge Graph:** Documents, collections and tags drawn as a network, linked by shared
collections and tags.
**Workflows:** Multi-step AI text pipelines run on demand, from four built-in templates or your
own.
**Research Mode:** Optional web search (Brave, Serper or SearXNG) that adds web results to AI
Chat answers. Off by default.
**Database encryption:** Optional SQLCipher encryption of the database with a key tied to your
Windows account. Off by default.

---

## Core Features

1. **Local by default:** the built-in model runs on your computer; nothing is sent to a cloud
   service unless you add a cloud provider, turn on Research Mode, connect a calendar or email
   account, or import from the web.
2. **Four AI providers:** Built-in LLM (Local), Ollama (Local), OpenAI and Anthropic Claude,
   one active at a time. Embeddings are chosen separately (built-in model or Ollama by
   default; OpenAI embedding models if set).
3. **Knowledge Vault import:** Import Files, Import Folder, drag and drop on an empty vault,
   watch folders; exact-duplicate check; automatic tags from the AI model.
4. **Ask Your Files:** multi-query rephrasing, HyDE for long questions, hybrid retrieval,
   reranking, and streamed answers with citations.
5. **Semantic Search:** Semantic, Keyword and Hybrid modes with collection, file type, relevance
   and date filters, saved filters and history.
6. **Document tools:** Compare Documents, Quick Actions (layered summary, key points,
   translation, duplicate scans, collection suggestions), annotations.
7. **Web and inbox:** Web Import (URLs, YouTube videos, RSS or Atom feeds, sitemaps), the
   browser extension and the Smart Inbox for triage, Google and Microsoft calendar and email
   connectors.
8. **Workflows:** five step types (AiPrompt, DocumentLookup, TextTransform, ConditionalBranch,
   OutputFormat), JSON import and export.
9. **Speech to text:** local Whisper transcription of imported audio files and AI Chat voice
   input, once the speech-to-text model is installed from Model Manager.
10. **Operations:** Backup & Restore (AES-256-GCM encrypted backups, optional schedule),
    Collaborative Sync through a shared folder, plugins (not sandboxed), a token-protected
    local REST API on localhost:9846, and an Android companion app.
11. **Six UI languages:** English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Simplified Chinese.

---

## Quick Reference

### Keyboard Shortcuts

- `Ctrl+K` or `Ctrl+Shift+P`: Command Palette
- `Ctrl+P`: Jump To (pages, documents, conversations)
- `F1` or `Ctrl+Shift+/` (shown in the app as `Ctrl+Shift+?`): Keyboard shortcuts list
- `Ctrl+N`: New conversation in AI Chat
- `Ctrl+D`: Dashboard
- `Ctrl+I`: Knowledge Vault
- `Ctrl+F` or `Ctrl+Shift+F`: Semantic Search
- `Ctrl+G`: Knowledge Graph
- `Ctrl+Shift+W`: Workflows
- `Ctrl+Shift+E`: Web Import
- `Ctrl+Shift+A`: Analytics
- `Ctrl+Shift+O`: Operations
- `Ctrl+,`: Settings
- `Ctrl+1` to `Ctrl+9`: Dashboard, AI Chat, Ask Your Files, Semantic Search, Knowledge Vault,
  Collections, Workflows, Model Manager, Settings
- `Win+Shift+A`: Quick Chat, from anywhere in Windows while Agent-X runs

### Supported File Formats

- Documents: PDF, DOCX, Markdown (.md, .markdown, .mdx), TXT
- Data and config: CSV, JSON, XML, LOG, YAML, TOML, INI, CFG
- Code: C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C, C++, Go, Rust, Swift, Kotlin, Ruby, PHP,
  HTML, CSS, SCSS, SQL, shell, XAML
- Images: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF (text read with Windows OCR)
- Audio: MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, WebM (transcribed locally with Whisper)
- Web shortcuts: .url, .webloc
- Not supported: legacy .doc, RTF, EPUB, XLSX, PPTX

### AI Providers

- **Built-in LLM (Local):** Llama 3.2 3B Instruct via LLamaSharp; CPU, or NVIDIA GPU layers
  when the CUDA 12 Toolkit is installed
- **Ollama (Local):** any model you pull; defaults `llama3.2` (chat) and `all-minilm`
  (embeddings)
- **OpenAI:** API key; default model `gpt-4o-mini`
- **Anthropic Claude:** API key; default model `claude-sonnet-5`; no embeddings

### Platform

- Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or later, or Windows 11
- x64 installers (Inno Setup); per-user install needs no administrator rights
- .NET 8 and WinUI 3 (Windows App SDK 1.6, bundled with the app)
- Data folder: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AgentX`

---

## Common Use Cases

**Document intelligence:**
- Ask questions across research papers, contracts or notes and check the cited passages
- Compare two or more documents: similarities, differences, contradictions
- Summarize a long document section by section

**Research and knowledge management:**
- Semantic and keyword search across the whole vault
- Collections and a knowledge graph to see how documents group
- Web pages, videos and feeds imported next to local documents

**Productivity:**
- Meeting notes turned into decisions and action items
- Repeatable multi-step AI workflows
- Weekly digest of what was imported, searched and discussed
